description: Eventtia lets event organizers work with their own Eventtia account from ChatGPT. Users can list their events and see attendee, seat and workshop metrics; look up attendees and check their check-in, checkpoint and payment status; register, update, confirm or reject attendee registrations; and manage attendee types, registration form fields, speakers, workshops, sessions and checkpoints. Sensitive attendee fields are redacted by default and only returned when the user explicitly asks for them. Requires signing in to an Eventtia account through OAuth; the app only accesses data from that account and has no visual interface of its own.
